body: You claimed the Sinkhorn bead while my volunteer/assignment request was pending; I will not edit your reserved paths. Same two paths. Please either incorporate the whole public config boundary after chief ruling or pause/hand off; a NaN-only patch leaves confirmed siblings of the same validator defect.
